rooms.name: Area 1: Collapsed Antechamber
rooms.description: a rubble-choked antechamber where a stair once rose
rooms.readAloud: Fallen masonry litters the floor. Two ways lead onward: an open arch east and a closed door to the south.

rooms.name: Area 2: Guard Post
rooms.description: a cramped guard post with a cold brazier

trap.description: a concealed pit beneath the water

rooms.name: Area 4: Shrine of the Pale Toad
rooms.description: a defaced shrine reeking of stagnant water
rooms.special: A squat idol of a toad squats on a cracked altar; its gemstone eyes are long pried out.
